findings.title: Residual rename race between overlapping invocations
findings.detail: sweep.execute_run now rechecks run_state before os.replace (R5 fixed), but the recheck and the rename are still two separate steps. REMOTE_RUN section 6 acknowledges this and requires disjoint shards for concurrent invocations.
findings.action: None required; keep the disjoint-shard rule.

findings.title: Local absolute path in design prose
findings.detail: Line 3 of design_go_ppi.md cites the protocol by an absolute /Users/... path. It is document prose, not a config, manifest, condition file or pin, so portability is unaffected.
findings.action: Optionally make it repo-relative the next time the design is edited.

checksPassed.1_amendment_and_counts: Unchanged from pass 1: the AM1 dated row is in protocol section 13 with the escaping rule and is mirrored in the design. Counts are 24/121/2,420 (20/101/2,020) everywhere, and the denominator stays 720.
checksPassed.2_singleton_packing: Unchanged: singleton_packs keeps only the per-target cap and the retention check. There are no pack-mate constraints, no slot cycling and no 24->20 packing fallback.
checksPassed.3_device_shard_resume_paths: R1 fixed: test paths come from __file__, and the no-machine-path test covers go_ppi_domain/tests. A relocated-copy G0 run passed 335 tests with 3 skipped, and the slow suite passed 3. R2-R6 are fixed: fences pair, /300 is excluded, the crashed-host recovery is documented, execute_run rechecks before the rename, and the make_conditions guard is 5 GB. The sweep keeps its 3 GB guard per 100-run invocation, with a design note.
